description: Find current deals, coupons, sales and offers from real businesses worldwide, for any product or service. Use when a person asks for a deal, discount, coupon, promotion or the best price on something, optionally near a place. Every result is confirmed by the business and carries its end date and terms where the business has set them. Leave the query out to list current deals for a place or category.

country.description: ISO country code or English name, e.g. "CA" or "Canada".

query.description: What the person wants, in plain words. Example: "oil change", "family dentist new patient", "project management software".

name: search_deals
title: Search current deals
